statement: AMD Instinct MI355X GPU infrastructure is now live in production at HUMAIN in Saudi Arabia, serving GPU-as-a-service customers on Cisco Silicon One-based networking.
why: A named sovereign customer moving from announcement to live production traffic is a real, bankable AMD accelerator win rather than a memorandum of understanding.

impact.mechanism: A production MI355X deployment with a paying sovereign cloud operator validates AMD's rack-scale stack and pulls accelerator, CPU and AI-fabric volume with it.

evidence.excerpt: AMD Instinct MI355X GPU-based AI infrastructure, built on Cisco Silicon One-based AI networking, is now live in Saudi Arabia and serving HUMAIN customers in the Kingdom and beyond

confidence.basis: Primary source: AMD's own investor-relations press release announcing the live deployment.
